skill.summary: AI Agent Skill for GitHub project analysis and nad.fun token launch. Analyzes repos, generates token identity/promo, and launches on nad.fun.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added generators for identity, reasoning, promo, nadfun API, and pipeline orchestration
- Introduced modular architecture under src/generators/ for token launch asset generation
- Expanded documentation for on-chain deployment and API integration with nad.fun
- Enhanced security guidance: all credentials now handled via local .env file only
- Quick Start and usage examples for agents included in the documentation
